mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.sales_volume as salesVolume, p.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, p.enabled, p.created_at as createTime, p.updated_at as updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.enabled = 1 OR p.enabled IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (name, description, price, stock, sales_volume, category_id, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, COALESCE(#{salesVolume}, 0), #{categoryId}, COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
SELECT FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_category c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND (p.enabled = 1 OR p.enabled IS NULL) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) as avgRating, COUNT(*) as reviewCount FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId}
SELECT product_id FROM promotion_products WHERE promotion_id = #{promotionId}
